narr: Showers and thunderstorms moved west across southeast Arizona from early morning into the evening. Heavy rain produced flooding in parts of the Tucson area as well as parts of Cochise and Santa Cruz counties.
ev: Two periods of heavy rain, each of 1 across much of the watershed, which was part of the Bighorn Fire burn scar, caused Sabino Creek to overtop bridges at the Sabino Canyon Recreation area. Some hiking trails, which were affected by high flows earlier in the month, sustained additional damage.
Heavy rain of 2 in 1 hour in the vicinity of Davis-Monthan AFB caused flash flooding and the closure of nearby roads including Contractors Way.

One inch of rain in less than 1 hour caused flash flooding near State Route 83 in the Lyle and Brushy Canyon areas south of Canelo. Two occupants of a pickup truck were rescued from three feet of flowing water.
Upstream heavy rain of 1.5-2.5 in 2 hours caused Canada Del Oro Wash to flood part of N Lago Del Oro Parkway, resulting in its closure.
